embedded.title: Filesystem access control list
embedded.description: Manage the discretionary and/or system access control list of a local file or folder.

path.title: Path
path.description: The path to the local file or folder.

accessControlList.title: Access control list
accessControlList.description: The discretionary (DACL) and/or system (SACL) access control list for the file or folder. At least one section must be present unless '_purge' is explicitly true, which clears omitted sections.

discretionary.title: Discretionary access control entries
discretionary.description: The discretionary access control list (DACL) entries. Omit to leave the DACL unmanaged unless '_purge' is explicitly true, in which case omission clears the DACL.

discretionaryProtected.title: Discretionary access control list is protected
discretionaryProtected.description: Whether the DACL is protected from inheriting entries from its parent. This is meaningful when 'discretionary' is provided or '_purge' is explicitly true. For a managed DACL, omission uses false for replacement and preserves the current value for merge.

system.title: System access control entries
system.description: The system access control list (SACL) entries. Omit to leave the SACL unmanaged unless '_purge' is explicitly true, in which case omission clears the SACL. Reading or writing this section requires the SeSecurityPrivilege privilege.

systemProtected.title: System access control list is protected
systemProtected.description: Whether the SACL is protected from inheriting entries from its parent. This is meaningful when 'system' is provided or '_purge' is explicitly true. For a managed SACL, omission uses false for replacement and preserves the current value for merge.

_purge.title: Purge access control lists
_purge.description: Controls replacement and merge behavior. When omitted, each supplied section is replaced and each omitted section remains unmanaged. Explicit true replaces both sections, clearing either section that is omitted. When false, supplied entries are merged into their corresponding current sections and omitted sections remain unmanaged.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: The security principal the entry applies to. Accepts either a SID string (for example 'S-1-5-32-544') or an account or group name (for example 'DOMAIN\User' or 'Administrators'). Names are resolved to a security identifier; output always reports the normalized SID string.

type.title: ACE type
type.description: Whether the entry allows, denies, or audits access. 'allow' and 'deny' are valid only in the discretionary list; 'audit' is valid only in the system list.

accessMask.title: Access mask
accessMask.description: The permissions granted, denied, or audited by this entry. The 'generic*' values represent the raw GENERIC_* access mask bits; Windows maps them to the equivalent file-specific rights (for example 'genericAll' to 'fullControl') and they're accepted so that an existing entry using them can always be read back and represented, but there's normally no reason to specify them in a request.

flags.title: ACE flags
flags.description: Inheritance flags for the entry. Defaults to an empty list (no inheritance).

auditFlags.title: Audit flags
auditFlags.description: The audit conditions for the entry. Required (and non-empty) when 'type' is 'audit'; must be empty otherwise.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PowerS.description: Indicates whether the instance is in the desired state. This property is only returned by the `test` method.
